proof_body:
by
  intro s a
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun x hx => h.1 hx, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have h' : a ≤ a - ε := h.2 (fun x hx => hc x hx)
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    refine ⟨fun x hx => h₁ x hx, fun b hb => ?_⟩
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := h₂ (a - b) (by linarith)
    have h' : x ≤ b := hb hx
    linarith
target_source: ∀ (s : Set ℝ) (a : ℝ), IsLUB s a ↔ ((∀ x ∈ s, x ≤ a) ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ x ∈ s, a - ε < x)
